description: Content list for scripts/release/New-SourceZip.ps1 -- a source-code-only archive of this repo. Paths are repo-relative with forward slashes, enumerated from 'git ls-files' (nothing untracked or gitignored can ever enter). A file is included when it matches ANY 'include' pattern and NO 'exclude' pattern; exclude always wins. Edit this file to change what ships -- the script itself carries no path knowledge.

include.note: All production Java + main resources for every module (dsl, kernel, adapters, generator, runtimehost, runtimehost-core, tools, db-history). Carries the mustache templates, npdev-templates/, engine-profiles.json and runtime-supported-controllers.json.
JSON Schema contracts: runtime, kernel, generator, authoring.
The 4th model.schema.json mirror (see CLAUDE.md) -- kept so the four copies stay complete.
Built-in packs shipped into every generated app: workspace, identity, project-tracker-demo.
Every build.gradle / settings.gradle in the tree.
NPDevRuntimeHost build.gradle.template + settings.gradle.template -- the generated app's build files.
Gradle wrapper properties AND the 6 wrapper jars, so the archive builds standalone.
The Python CLI (npdev_cli, npdev_monitor, npdev_explore, npdev_diagram, npdev_engines, migrations, ...). Top level only -- NPDevCli/tests/ is out.
Tauri desktop Manager: Rust src, ui/, Cargo manifests, tauri.conf.json, capabilities, icons. fixtures/ excluded below.

The build/run scripts that stay: Build-NpdevApp / Build-ClaudeApp / Build-AppGenApp / Rebuild-And-Restage / New-*Page emitters, sync-runtimehost-libs, and the sample generate/run/verify/clean/normalize/sync helpers.
Shared PowerShell helpers dot-sourced by the build scripts above.
The only scripts/policy file a kept script reads (sync-mirrored-samples.ps1). Every other policy file belongs to a quality gate and is out.
Root entry points and repo metadata. README + LICENSE are the only markdown/legal files that ship.

exclude.note: All test sources and test resources in every module -- 551 *Test.java plus fixtures.
Sample app corpus is out entirely, including the three probe capability sources that would otherwise match src/main/.

textExclude.note: TEXT PACK ONLY (New-Source-npx.ps1). Binary -- a zip can carry it, a text pack cannot.
TEXT PACK ONLY. ~450 KB of minified, generated JS/CSS -- unreadable and a very large share of the token budget. Stays in the zip because a build needs it.
